_comment: The hate / identity-attack tier. TF-IDF word 1-2 grams + logistic
regression, trained on UC Berkeley's Measuring Hate Speech
(CC BY 4.0 — ATTRIBUTION IS REQUIRED IN THE PRODUCT'S NOTICES).
Positives are identity-targeted (race, religion, origin, gender,
sexuality, age, disability); negatives are the corpus's clearly-
not-hate end. No corpus text is reproduced here, only per-term
The threshold is the 99.9th percentile of held-out negatives:
measured to flag 0 of 4,827 real personal SMS and 0 of 30
legitimate-identity-talk checklist items, while catching 28% of
message-length hate. A findings tier accuses people, so it runs at
the precise end and accepts the recall cost.
attribution: UC Berkeley D-Lab, Measuring Hate Speech (CC BY 4.0)
